ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a large outer square with a gray smaller square drawn as a diamond inside it. The diamond’s four vertices lie at the midpoints of the four sides of the outer square. The bottom side of the outer square is labeled 10 cm. Reasoning: Since the inner diamond is a square whose left and right vertices are the midpoints of the left and right sides of the outer square, its horizontal diagonal spans the full width of the outer square. Therefore the inner square’s diagonal is 10 cm. For a square, area = diagonal^2 / 2, so the area is 10^2 / 2 = 100 / 2 = 50 cm^2.

method.method_draft: Use area subtraction. Read from the image that the smaller square leaves four congruent right triangles in the corners of the large square. Read from the text that the large square has side length 10 cm and that the vertices of the smaller square are side midpoints. Each side of the large square is split into two segments of length 5 cm, so each corner triangle has legs 5 cm and 5 cm. Each triangle has area (1/2)(5)(5)=12.5 cm^2, and four such triangles have total area 50 cm^2. The large square area is 10^2=100 cm^2, so the smaller square area is 100-50=50 cm^2.
